movelist.name: Rock Tomb
movelist.effect: Rock Tomb lowers the target’s Speed by -1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Curse
movelist.effect: If the user is not a Ghost Type, Curse has a Frequency of EOT, and when used the user lowers its Speed by -1 Combat Stage, but raises Attack and Defense by +1 Combat Stage each.  If the user is a Ghost Type, Curse has a Frequency of Scene, and when used the user loses 1/3rd of their Max Hit Points and a target Pokémon or Trainer within 8 meters of the user becomes Cursed. This Hit Point loss cannot be prevented in any way.

movelist.name: Mud Sport
movelist.effect: All targets in the burst, including the user, gain a Coat which grants them 1 Step of Resistance to Electric Type Moves. After a target has been hit by a damaging Electric Type Move, the coat is removed.

movelist.name: Harden
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Defense 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Weak Armor
abilities.effect: The user may lower its Defense by 1 Combat Stage, and gain +1 Speed Combat Stage. This is done after the triggering damage is resolved.
